item.title: CalDeck 0.1.0 (43)
item.description:
Stop the repeated keychain password prompts after updates

  • Login and license data now live in a private folder (0700/0600) in
  • Application Support instead of the keychain. Without an Apple team ID,
  • macOS ties keychain access to the exact build, so every update asked for
  • the password once per item. Old keychain items are no longer read; a
  • Microsoft sign-in has to be done once more.
